primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-colim-f-shriek-separated (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 924-937

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: test the canonical map on sections over quasi-compact objects, observe the colimit is directed with injective transition maps, evaluate it with the directed colimits sections lemma, and reduce to the observation that a closed subset of X_V proper over V is quasi-compact and hence contained in a single member of the covering (source lines 939-950)
